title: Mapterhorn
description: Mapterhorn is a global collection of terrain tiles in PMTiles format for use in interactive web map visualizations. The dataset covers the full extent of the Web Mercator projection and provides digital elevation model data encoded in Terrarium format, suitable for hillshading and 3D terrain rendering. Sources are open-data providers listed on the Mapterhorn attribution page.
